threat.detail: Imhotep, an ancient Egyptian high priest, disguised as Ardath Bey
threat.quote: the film features Karloff as Imhotep, an ancient Egyptian mummy who was killed for attempting to resurrect his dead lover

origin.detail: Imhotep was buried alive as punishment for sacrilege
origin.quote: although Imhotep had been wrapped like a traditional mummy, he had been buried alive

origin.detail: Norton reads the Scroll of Thoth
origin.quote: He translates the symbols and then reads the words aloud, causing Imhotep to rise from the dead

wants.detail: Ankh-es-en-Amon, whom he believes reincarnated in Helen
wants.quote: searches for Anck-es-en-Amon, who he believes has been reincarnated in the modern world
he attempts to make her his immortal bride by killing, mummifying, and resurrecting her

wrong.detail: Imhotep tried to resurrect the princess
wrong.quote: his horrific death was punishment for sacrilege, as he attempted to resurrect his lover

trigger.detail: Norton opens the cursed casket despite a warning
trigger.quote: Despite Muller's warning, Sir Joseph's assistant, Ralph Norton, opens it and finds an ancient, life-giving scroll

rules.detail: burning the Scroll of Thoth ends his immortality
rules.quote: sets the Scroll of Thoth on fire, breaking the spell that had given Imhotep his immortality
hypnotizes Joseph's Nubian servant to be his slave and bring the Scroll to him

who_suffers.detail: Norton goes insane; Sir Joseph is killed
who_suffers.quote: Sir Joseph's assistant Norton went insane and died laughing shortly afterward
Helen Grosvenor, a half-Egyptian woman who bears a striking resemblance to the princess

ending.detail: Isis burns the scroll and Imhotep turns to dust
ending.quote: his body dies and turns to dust
Ankh-es-en-Amon's spirit leaves Helen's body, as Helen awakens as herself
